welcome.title:
However today feels,
start where you are.
welcome.description: Meet Zen. A gentle companion for reflection, everyday wellbeing, and small steps forward.
welcome.note: MindGuard is a non-clinical academic wellness prototype. Use invented details only.

chat.subtitle: Your wellness companion

voice.title: A moment to talk.

tone.title:
A little insight.
Your perspective first.
tone.description: Voice tone feedback offers an uncertain estimate of how you may sound.
tone.note: Observations can be wrong. They are not a diagnosis and never determine alerts.

history.title: Conversations.

preferences.title:
Your conversations.
Your choices.
preferences.description: Choose what stays after a conversation.
preferences.note: Auto-delete is measured from when a conversation starts. It runs when the app opens, returns to the foreground, and while active; it cannot run while the app is closed.

memories.description: Details you explicitly ask to keep for future conversations.
